purpose: Durable human-facing map of Prometeo projects plus a deduplicated fallback backlog for surplus /wc capacity. This survives chat loss; workers claim jobs before execution and return evidence durably.
truth_law: A project, job, claim or return is not Current/Human Accepted/Served merely because it exists here. Unknown implementation state stays discovery/archaeology until exact evidence is recovered.

capacity_policy.portfolio_fallback_when: No higher-value compatible claimable queue/recovery work remains after a fresh state reload, or the prepared frontier is saturated by other workers.
capacity_policy.idle_policy: Do not idle while a compatible unclaimed portfolio job exists. Never invent filler only to keep a worker occupied.

projects.label: Prometeo · crecimiento autónomo
projects.goal: Convert durable returns into useful successor work and successive generations without human routing, while preserving verification and authority boundaries.

jobs.title: Cerrar un ciclo productivo G2 → G3 con evidencia durable
jobs.mission: Tomar el compounding frontier actual, identificar el bloqueo exacto que impide que trabajo derivado de G2 se ejecute y produzca G3, implementar o desbloquear el siguiente paso permitido y dejar receipts verificables.
definition_of_done: Existe evidencia durable de consumo del resultado previo.
Se crea o activa trabajo sucesor sin diseño manual ad hoc del humano.
El sucesor se ejecuta o queda bloqueado por una frontera exacta y demostrada, no por falta de routing.
No se declara autonomía global sin verificador independiente.

projects.label: Prometeo Live
projects.goal: Make ongoing work, project backlog and real compounding legible from one live surface.

jobs.title: Mostrar crecimiento real además de completion
jobs.mission: Extend Live so project/backlog activity and successor creation are visible, and distinguish plan completion from reproduction/compounding.
definition_of_done: Live muestra proyectos y trabajos portfolio con ready/working/done.
Live no presenta 100% de ejecución como crecimiento autónomo.
Nuevos jobs/claims/returns aparecen desde durable state sin hardcode manual por job.

projects.label: Alumnos / Student World
projects.goal: Recover the actual teaching surfaces and continue shipping visible student-facing improvements instead of repeatedly rediscovering the project.

jobs.title: Recuperar superficie actual de Alumnos y fijar próximo cambio visible
jobs.mission: Resolve the current student/teacher surface from durable workstreams/catalog/history, record exact paths/URLs and current state, then identify one non-duplicate visible next improvement with evidence.
definition_of_done: Quedan registrados paths/URLs exactos de la superficie vigente o una SOURCE_DEBT explícita.
Se evita reconstruir desde cero un diseño ya existente.
Queda un sucesor concreto y verificable para implementación.

projects.label: José · tareas y estudio
projects.goal: Recover the durable José lane, distinguish finished material from pending work, and create the next useful student-facing task only when evidence supports it.

jobs.title: Separar trabajo de José terminado vs pendiente
jobs.mission: Trace José-related durable workstreams and receipts, produce an evidence-backed open/closed inventory, and surface only truly pending student-facing work.
definition_of_done: No se vuelve a ejecutar material ya cerrado.
Cada pendiente tiene fuente y aceptación concreta.
Si no hay pendiente real, el retorno lo declara en vez de inventar ejercicios.

projects.label: Facultad · parciales y materias
projects.goal: Recover and unify the real faculty/exam surfaces so each subject can reuse the same reliable study shell without losing subject-specific content.

jobs.title: Inventariar página de parcial y materias reales
jobs.mission: Locate the current Facultad/study/partial implementations and content sources, map reusable vs subject-specific pieces, and persist exact evidence before proposing consolidation.
definition_of_done: Existe inventario de superficies y fuentes reales.
Se identifica qué puede compartir shell y qué debe seguir por materia.
Queda un próximo cambio visible, pequeño y verificable.

projects.label: Herramienta texto → audio
projects.goal: Recover the existing text-to-audio implementation and make its actual state, entry point and next defect/improvement durable.

jobs.title: Encontrar y verificar herramienta texto → audio
jobs.mission: Search repository/catalog/history for the actual text-to-audio tool, verify its entry point and behavior, then persist exact paths/URLs and one evidence-backed next step. Do not rebuild it from scratch unless absence is proven.
definition_of_done: Ruta/URL exacta recuperada o ausencia documentada con SOURCE_DEBT.
Estado funcional verificado sin claims de capacidad no probada.
Siguiente trabajo deduplicado identificado.

projects.label: Herramienta audio → texto
projects.goal: Recover the existing transcription implementation and make its actual state and next useful improvement durable.

jobs.title: Encontrar y verificar herramienta audio → texto
jobs.mission: Search repository/catalog/history for the actual audio-to-text/transcription tool, verify the current implementation and entry point, and persist exact evidence plus one useful next step. Never claim live transcription without receipts.
definition_of_done: Ruta/URL exacta recuperada o ausencia documentada.
Capacidades verificadas se separan de las aspiracionales.
Siguiente trabajo deduplicado identificado.

projects.label: Scroll / visualizador de texto
projects.goal: Recover the existing text-scroll/reader experiments, select the strongest baseline and avoid rebuilding motion/interaction from zero.

jobs.title: Recuperar baseline real del visualizador de texto
jobs.mission: Locate current and historical scroll/text visualizer artifacts, compare evidence of accepted interaction behavior, and persist the baseline plus exact unresolved defects.
definition_of_done: Baseline exacto recuperado con bytes/path cuando existan.
No se sustituye una interacción aceptada por un rediseño genérico.
Pendientes quedan convertidos en jobs concretos.

projects.label: Calendario y hábitos
projects.goal: Recover the actual calendar/habits work and turn vague pending intent into a minimal useful surface or verified next change.

jobs.title: Recuperar estado real de calendario y hábitos
jobs.mission: Search durable state and published surfaces for calendar/habits work, separate existing capability from ideas, and persist a concrete next user-visible job only after evidence is found.
definition_of_done: Existing vs planned is explicit.
Exact source/surface or SOURCE_DEBT is recorded.
One useful non-duplicate successor is identified.

projects.label: Tele / pantalla
projects.goal: Recover what the pending television/display work actually was before allocating implementation time.

jobs.title: Recuperar pendiente real de la tele
jobs.mission: Trace durable history/artifacts for the television/display lane, identify the actual unfinished outcome and exact source bytes if they exist, then create a bounded successor job. Do not guess the product from the label alone.
definition_of_done: Intent and artifacts are grounded in durable evidence or SOURCE_DEBT is explicit.
No speculative rebuild is started.
A bounded successor exists only if evidence supports it.
